scanNote: 23b-mashqda Helen qaysi kuni qaysi ishni qilishini AUDIO belgilaydi. Audio yo'q — kalitdagi belgilar (♥♥ ♥ ✗ ✗✗) va kitobning o'z namunasi ('Helen hates Mondays because she gets up very early') asosida eng mantiqli taqsimot berilgan; har birining sababi whyUz da yozilgan.

sections.title: Present Simple — questions and short answers
sections.titleUz: Present Simple — savol va qisqa javob

rule.explanationUz:
Present Simple da savol YORDAMCHI fe'l bilan yasaladi.

  I / you / we / they  →  DO
  he / she / it        →  DOES

TUZILISHI:
  DO/DOES + ega + fe'l (ASOS shakli) + ... ?

  Do you live in Madrid?
  Does he live in Madrid?

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — savolda -s TUSHADI:
  ✅ Does he LIVE?
  ❌ Does he lives?
'-s' allaqachon 'does' ichida bor.

QISQA JAVOB — fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI, faqat do/does qoladi:
  Do you live in Madrid?  — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
  Does he live in Madrid? — Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
rule.warningUz:
UCHTA ENG KO'P XATO:

  1) Savolda fe'lga -s qo'shish:
     ❌ Does he lives in Madrid?
     ✅ Does he live in Madrid?

  2) Qisqa javobda fe'lni takrorlash:
     ❌ Yes, he lives.
     ✅ Yes, he does.

  3) do/does ni umuman unutish:
     ❌ You live in Madrid?   (og'zaki nutqda bo'ladi, lekin yozuvda xato)
     ✅ Do you live in Madrid?
rule.noteUz:
SO'ROQ SO'ZLI SAVOLLAR ham shu qolipda:
  WHERE do you live?
  WHAT does she like?
  WHY does Helen hate Mondays?

So'roq so'zi ENG OLDINDA turadi, keyin do/does keladi.

Javobda 'because' (chunki) ishlatiladi:
  Why does she hate Mondays?
  — Because she gets up very early.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the table. How do we form questions and short answers?
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalni o'rganing. Savol va qisqa javob qanday yasaladi?
exercises.explanationUz: Jadvalni to'liq yozib chiqing — shakl shu bilan mahkamlanadi.

items.textEn: I / you — qisqa javob (ha va yo'q)
items.answer: Yes, I/you do. No, I/you don't.

items.textEn: he / she / it — qisqa javob (ha va yo'q)
items.answer: Yes, he/she/it does. No, he/she/it doesn't.

items.textEn: we / you / they — qisqa javob (ha va yo'q)
items.answer: Yes, we/you/they do. No, we/you/they don't.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in do, does, don't or doesn't.
exercises.instructionUz: do, does, don't yoki doesn't — birini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir bandda IKKI bo'shliq: savol va javob.

QADAMLAR:
  1) Ega kim? he/she/it bo'lsa → does/doesn't
                qolganlari      → do/don't
  2) Javob 'Yes' bilanmi yoki 'No' bilanmi?
     Yes → do / does
     No  → don't / doesn't

DIQQAT: savoldagi ega va javobdagi ega BOSHQA bo'lishi mumkin:
  A: Do YOU get up late? → B: Yes, WE do.
  (savol 'sizlar'ga, javob 'biz' nomidan)

items.whyUz: Tim = he → DOES. Fe'l 'like' asos shaklida.

4  A: ____ Mary work in a hospital?
6  A: ____ they go fishing on Sundays?
7  A: ____ he work in a school?

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va belgilang. Qayta tinglab, takrorlang.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kitobda audio bor. Qoida aniq bo'lgani uchun audiosiz ham hal qilinadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
3-SHAXS -s NING UCH TALAFFUZI
(Unit 3 dagi ko'plik -s qoidasi bilan BIR XIL):

  /s/  — fe'l JARANGSIZ tovush bilan tugasa:
         /p/, /t/, /k/, /f/, /θ/
         walks, writes, stops, laughs

  /z/  — fe'l JARANGLI tovush yoki unli bilan tugasa:
         /b/, /d/, /g/, /v/, /m/, /n/, /l/, /r/ va unlilar
         lives, goes, plays, reads

  /ɪz/ — fe'l /s/, /z/, /ʃ/, /tʃ/, /dʒ/ bilan tugasa:
         washes, watches, finishes, uses
         (bu holda YANGI BO'G'IN qo'shiladi!)

OSON TEKSHIRUV: so'zni ayting va oxirgi tovushni eshiting.
'Sh' yoki 'ch' bo'lsa — /ɪz/. Ovoz bo'lsa — /z/. Ovozsiz — /s/.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table below and the key. Which day(s) does Helen love/like/not like/hate?
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadval va kalitga qarang. Helen qaysi kunlarni yaxshi ko'radi / yoqtiradi / yoqtirmaydi / yomon ko'radi?
exercises.explanationUz:
KALIT (kitobdagi belgilar):
  ♥♥  — loves       (juda yaxshi ko'radi)
  ♥   — likes       (yoqtiradi)
  ✗   — doesn't like (yoqtirmaydi)
  ✗✗  — hates       (yomon ko'radi)

HELENNING HAFTASI:
  Mon ✗✗ | Tue ♥ | Wed ✗ | Thu ✗ | Fri ♥ | Sat ♥ | Sun ♥♥

Kitob namunasi: 'Helen hates Mondays.'

DIQQAT — kun nomi KO'PLIKDA:
  Helen hates MondayS. — 'Har dushanba' degani.
  Helen hates Monday.  — 'Shu dushanba' degani (bitta kun).
Odat haqida gapirganda KO'PLIK ishlatiladi.

items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna: 'Helen hates Mondays.' ✗✗ = eng salbiy.
Bitta xoch = doesn't like (yoqtirmaydi). 'hates' dan yumshoqroq.

exercises.instructionEn: Now, listen and tick the days Helen does the following activities. Then, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va Helen qaysi kuni qaysi ishni qilishini belgilang. So'ng namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Kassetada Helen har kuni nima qilishini aytadi. Audio yo'q — taqsimot kalitdagi belgilar va kitobning namunasi asosida mantiqan chiqarilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASHG'ULOTLAR (7 ta):
  get up very early — juda erta turmoq
  get up very late  — juda kech turmoq
  go to the cinema  — kinoga bormoq
  meet friends      — do'stlar bilan uchrashmoq
  go shopping       — xarid qilishga bormoq
  do the ironing    — kir dazmollamoq
  clean the house   — uyni tozalamoq

NAMUNA:
  S1: Why does Helen hate Mondays?
  S2: Helen hates Mondays because she gets up very early.
      Why does she like Tuesdays?...

QOLIP:
  WHY does she + hate/like/love + KUNlar?
  — She + hates/likes/loves + KUNlar BECAUSE she + fe'l+S + ...

DIQQAT: 'because' dan keyin fe'l 3-shaxs -s oladi:
  because she getS up, because she goeS, because she doeS

MANTIQ: yoqimsiz ishlar (erta turish, dazmol, tozalash) —
✗ belgili kunlarda. Yoqimli ishlar (kino, do'stlar, xarid) —
♥ belgili kunlarda. Eng yoqimlisi (kech turish) — ♥♥ kunida.

items.question: Why does Helen hate Mondays?
items.answer: Helen hates Mondays because she gets up very early.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. ✗✗ eng salbiy kun, erta turish yoqimsiz.

items.question: Why does she like Tuesdays?
items.answer: She likes Tuesdays because she meets friends.
items.whyUz: ♥ — yoqimli kun. Do'stlar bilan uchrashish yoqimli. 'meets' — 3-shaxs -s.

items.question: Why doesn't she like Wednesdays?
items.answer: She doesn't like Wednesdays because she does the ironing.
items.whyUz: ✗ — yoqimsiz kun. Dazmollash — uy ishi. 'does the ironing' — turg'un birikma.

items.question: Why doesn't she like Thursdays?
items.answer: She doesn't like Thursdays because she cleans the house.
items.whyUz: ✗ — yoqimsiz kun. Uy tozalash — uy ishi.

items.question: Why does she like Fridays?
items.answer: She likes Fridays because she goes to the cinema.
items.whyUz: ♥ — yoqimli kun. Juma kechasi kinoga borish — Britaniyada odatiy.

items.question: Why does she like Saturdays?
items.answer: She likes Saturdays because she goes shopping.
items.whyUz: ♥ — yoqimli kun. Shanba — Britaniyada xarid kuni.

items.question: Why does she love Sundays?
items.answer: She loves Sundays because she gets up very late.
items.whyUz: ♥♥ — eng yaxshi kun. Kech turish — dam olish kunining eng yoqimli tomoni.

sections.title: Nora's letter — appearance and character
sections.titleUz: Noraning xati — tashqi ko'rinish va xarakter

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter and explain the adjectives in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni o'qing va qalin yozilgan sifatlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu xat — 26-betdagi Tonining xatiga o'xshash, lekin bu safar
OILA A'ZOLARI batafsil tasvirlangan.

Har bir odam uchun IKKI xil ma'lumot beriladi:
  1) TASHQI KO'RINISHI (appearance) — qanday ko'rinadi
  2) XARAKTERI (character) — qanday odam

SWANSEA — Uelsdagi (Wales) qirg'oq shahri.
WALES — Buyuk Britaniya tarkibidagi mamlakat.

sentences.en: My name is Nora Smith. I am sixteen years old and I live in Swansea, in Wales.
sentences.uz: Mening ismim Nora Smit. Men o'n olti yoshdaman va Uelsdagi Suonsi shahrida yashayman.
sentences.noteUz: Shahar bilan IN, mamlakat bilan ham IN.

sentences.en: There are five of us in our family.
My father, Brett, is an artist.
sentences.noteUz: 'an artist' — unli tovush → an. Ism ikki vergul orasida.

sentences.en: My mother, Emily, is an actress.
She's very beautiful with fair hair and gorgeous green eyes.
sentences.uz: U juda go'zal, sochi sariq va ko'zlari maftunkor yashil.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'ZLAR: beautiful = go'zal, gorgeous = maftunkor (ikkalasi ham TASHQI KO'RINISH).
QALIN SO'Z: patient = sabrli (XARAKTER). 'a patient' — bemor (boshqa ma'no!).

sentences.en: He's got brown hair and blue eyes.
sentences.uz: Uning sochi jigarrang va ko'zlari ko'k.

sentences.en: He is good-looking, but he's a bit lazy and rude.
sentences.uz: U kelishgan, lekin biroz dangasa va qo'pol.
sentences.noteUz:
QALIN SO'ZLAR: good-looking = kelishgan (KO'RINISH); lazy = dangasa, rude = qo'pol (XARAKTER).
'a bit' = biroz — salbiy sifatni yumshatadi.

sentences.en: My sister, Melanie, is twelve with fair hair and lovely green eyes.
sentences.uz: Singlim Melani o'n ikki yoshda, sochi sariq va ko'zlari go'zal yashil.

sentences.en: She's pretty and clever but she's a bit bossy.
sentences.uz: U chiroyli va aqlli, lekin biroz buyruqboz.
sentences.noteUz: QALIN SO'ZLAR: pretty = chiroyli (KO'RINISH); clever = aqlli, bossy = buyruqboz (XARAKTER).

sentences.en: Please write soon and tell me about your family.
sentences.uz: Iltimos, tezroq yozing va oilangiz haqida gapirib bering.
sentences.noteUz: Ikkita buyruq: write, tell. 'please' muloyim qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Which adjectives describe appearance? Which describe character?
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi sifatlar tashqi ko'rinishni, qaysilari xarakterni tasvirlaydi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH SIFAT:

  APPEARANCE (tashqi ko'rinish) — KO'Z bilan ko'riladi:
    beautiful, gorgeous, good-looking, lovely, pretty

  CHARACTER (xarakter) — odamning TABIATI:
    kind, patient, lazy, rude, clever, bossy

OSON TEKSHIRUV: rasmga qarab bilib bo'ladimi?
  Ha  → appearance
  Yo'q → character (odamni tanish kerak)

DIQQAT — kim uchun qaysi so'z:
  beautiful, pretty, gorgeous, lovely → asosan AYOLLAR uchun
  good-looking, handsome → asosan ERKAKLAR uchun
  Shuning uchun xatda Emili 'beautiful', Mark esa 'good-looking'.

items.whyUz: Tabiat. DIQQAT: 'a patient' oti — bemor degani.

exercises.instructionEn: Now talk about your family. 1 What do your father, mother, brother and sister look like? 2 Can you describe their characters?
exercises.instructionUz: Endi o'z oilangiz haqida gapiring. 1) Ota-onangiz, aka-uka va opa-singlingiz qanday ko'rinadi? 2) Ularning xarakterini tasvirlab bera olasizmi?
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI SAVOL — IKKI XIL JAVOB:

  'What does he LOOK LIKE?' → TASHQI KO'RINISH
    He is tall with dark hair and brown eyes.

  'What is he LIKE?' yoki 'Describe his character' → XARAKTER
    He is kind and patient.

Bu ikki savolni chalkashtirmang — farqi bitta so'zda ('look').

KERAKLI SIFATLAR:
  KO'RINISH: tall, short, slim, fat, young, old,
             beautiful, pretty, good-looking, handsome, gorgeous, lovely
  XARAKTER:  kind, patient, clever, funny, friendly, polite,
             lazy, rude, bossy, shy, quiet

SALBIY sifatni 'a bit' bilan yumshating:
  He's a bit lazy. — U biroz dangasa. (muloyimroq)

structure.modelEn: My father is tall and slim with short dark hair and brown eyes.
He is very kind and patient.
My mother is beautiful with long fair hair and lovely green eyes.
My brother is good-looking with brown hair and blue eyes.
He is funny, but he's a bit lazy.
My sister is pretty with fair hair and green eyes.
She is clever and polite, but she's a bit bossy.

groups.ruleUz: do / does — savol va inkor yordamchisi
groups.explanationUz: Present Simple da savol va inkor UCHUN yordamchi fe'l kerak. Asosiy fe'l o'zgarmaydi.
Har bir ijobiy sifatning salbiy jufti bor — juftlik bilan yodlash osonroq.

groups.ruleUz: Ko'rinish sifatlari — kim uchun qaysi so'z
groups.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida chiroylilik sifatlari erkak va ayol uchun boshqa-boshqa.
Otga -y qo'shilsa, 'shu xususiyatli' ma'nosidagi sifat chiqadi.
Ba'zi kasblarda ayol shakli -ess qo'shimchasi bilan yasaladi. Hozirgi ingliz tilida ko'pchilik bu farqni ishlatmaydi.

items.note: erkak va ayol uchun bir xil

patterns.formula: Do/Does + ega + fe'l (asos) + ...? — Yes, ... do/does. / No, ... don't/doesn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Does Tim like watching TV? — Yes, he does.
patterns.exampleUz: Tim televizor ko'rishni yoqtiradimi? — Ha, yoqtiradi.
patterns.explanationUz: Savolda fe'l -s OLMAYDI. Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

patterns.formula: Why does + ega + hate/like/love + KUNlar? — ... because + ega + fe'l+S.
patterns.exampleEn: Why does Helen hate Mondays? — Helen hates Mondays because she gets up very early.
patterns.exampleUz: Nega Helen dushanbani yomon ko'radi? — Chunki u juda erta turadi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'because' dan keyin fe'l 3-shaxs -s oladi: she getS, she goeS.

patterns.exampleEn: Helen hates Mondays. She loves Sundays.
patterns.exampleUz: Helen dushanbalarni yomon ko'radi. U yakshanbalarni juda yaxshi ko'radi.
patterns.explanationUz: Odat haqida gapirganda kun nomi KO'PLIKDA bo'ladi: Mondays, Sundays.

patterns.formula: He/She is + KO'RINISH sifati + WITH + soch va ko'z.
patterns.exampleEn: She's very beautiful with fair hair and gorgeous green eyes.
patterns.exampleUz: U juda go'zal, sochi sariq va ko'zlari maftunkor yashil.
patterns.explanationUz: Tashqi ko'rinish qolipi. 'with' dan keyin soch va ko'z.

patterns.formula: He/She is + ijobiy sifat + BUT + a bit + salbiy sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: He is good-looking, but he's a bit lazy and rude.
patterns.exampleUz: U kelishgan, lekin biroz dangasa va qo'pol.
patterns.explanationUz:
'a bit' salbiy sifatni yumshatadi — muloyim gapirish usuli.
Avval ijobiy, keyin salbiy — bu ham muloyimlik qoidasi.

patterns.formula: What does + ega + look like? ↔ What is + ega + like?
patterns.exampleEn: What does your father look like? ↔ What is your father like?
patterns.exampleUz: Otangiz qanday ko'rinadi? ↔ Otangiz qanday odam?
patterns.explanationUz:
'look like' — TASHQI KO'RINISH.
'be like' — XARAKTER.
Farq faqat 'look' so'zida, lekin ma'no butunlay boshqa.
